qa_pair.question: On Thursday 26 November 2026 you want to go by train from Plzeň hl.n. to České Budějovice, leaving Plzeň at 10:00 or later. Take the first connection IDOS offers (it is a direct train). At how many intermediate stations does that train stop between Plzeň hl.n. and České Budějovice (excluding both of them)? Answer with a number only.

On Thursday 26 November 2026 you travel from Olomouc hl.n. to Jeseník on the first train connection departing Olomouc at 08:00 or later. According to IDOS, how many kilometres long is your journey from Olomouc hl.n. to Jeseník? Answer with a whole number of kilometres only.

On Wednesday 25 November 2026, take the first direct train from Praha hl.n. to Klatovy departing at 07:00 or later. At what time is it scheduled to arrive in Přeštice? Answer in H:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 9:41).

On Thursday 26 November 2026, what is the scheduled arrival time in Praha hl.n. of the first Leo Express train that departs from Ostrava hl.n. at 08:00 or later towards Prague? Answer in H:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 9:41).

The fast train R 321 "Silva Nortica" leaves Praha hl.n. on the morning of Wednesday 25 November 2026. How many kilometres does it travel between Tábor and its final station, according to the distances IDOS lists for its route? Answer with a whole number of kilometres only.

Brno tram line 1 runs from Řečkovice to Ečerova, starting in tariff zone 101, passing through zone 100 in the centre, and returning to zone 101 before Ečerova. Identify the last stop in zone 100 before the tram re-enters zone 101 on its way to Ečerova. At what time does the first tram 1 towards Ečerova depart from that stop on Wednesday 25 November 2026? Answer in H:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 9:41).

In Prague, tram line 22 towards Bílá Hora has some trips that end early (at Vypich or at Pražský hrad). On Wednesday 25 November 2026, what is the scheduled departure time from the stop Malostranské náměstí of the first tram 22 at or after 12:00 that runs all the way to Bílá Hora? Answer in H:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 9:41).

On Thursday 26 November 2026 you board Plzeň tram line 4 at the stop Zoologická zahrada and ride to the terminus Univerzita. According to the posted timetable, how many minutes is the scheduled ride? Answer with a number of minutes only.

On Wednesday 25 November 2026 you ride the railjet rj 275 "Metropolitan" from Praha hl.n. to Brno hl.n. In Brno you continue on tram line 1 from the stop Hlavní nádraží towards Ečerova. According to the posted tram timetable, at what time does the first tram 1 towards Ečerova leave Hlavní nádraží after the train's scheduled arrival in Brno hl.n.? Answer in H:MM 24-hour format (e.g. 9:41).

On Thursday 26 November 2026 you take the first train-only connection from Praha hl.n. to Český Krumlov that departs at 08:00 or later; it has one change, in České Budějovice. The train you change to does not end in Český Krumlov. How many kilometres is that train's complete run from České Budějovice to its final station? Answer with a whole number of kilometres only.
